title: review: goal/T-1667 final review fixes: never reopen a closed PR, gate before push, already-in-target, --once skips ship, and 7 more
spec:
Final fixes on goal/T-1667 before it goes to main, from an independent full-branch review (Planner-run,
2026-10-07, REQUEST_CHANGES; tests 473 run, only the 2 known Render merge-base errors; no shell=True, no force-push,
no push to main, rollback and state writes sound). Base: goal/T-1667. Fix all of these, each with a named test:

F1 high ship.py:157 (+:293-299, :211): _find_pr drops CLOSED PRs, so a PR a human closed/rejected gets replaced by a new
   one that ship merges unattended. If the goal has a CLOSED unmerged PR and no MERGED/OPEN one: hold "ship PR closed"
   and notify once; never open a new PR for it. test_closed_pr_holds_instead_of_reopening.
F2 med ship.py:207-216, :264-275: the merged tree is pushed as the PR head before the gate runs. Gate the local worktree
   first and push only after green; stamp gate_ok with gated_head_sha only after green; _on_merged requires a post-merge
   gate unless the PR's headRefOid equals a green gated_head_sha. test_push_only_after_green_gate,
   test_retry_after_red_gate_never_marks_shipped.
F3 med ship.py:190, :224: a transient git fetch failure raises _Hold. Make fetch failures count toward MAX_ERRORS
   (OSError-class), hold only after the limit. test_fetch_failure_counts_as_error.
F4 low ship.py:188-212, :351: a goal whose head is already an ancestor of origin/<target> is marked shipped
   ("already in target") without push or PR (three old closed goals in this repo are like that). test_already_in_target_ships_without_push.
F5 low daemon.py:1990: `daemon --once` must not run ship inline (it can block for hours); skip ship under --once.
   test_once_skips_ship.
F6 low daemon.py:2066-2075, ship.py:381: ship.tick refuses to start a thread once threading.main_thread() is not alive,
   and the MCP autostart sets stop_event on shutdown. test_no_ship_thread_after_main_exit.
F7 low goals.py:358, planner_shadow.py:59, claude_cli.py:34: put the resolved absolute path in argv[0] (as spawn.run_claude
   does) and handle None with a clear error; fix the argv() docstring. test_goals_and_shadow_use_absolute_argv0.
F8 low daemon.py:1643: legacy fix-round fallback keeps max(stamped reviews_expected, 1) and opens that many lineage
   reviews. test_legacy_fix_round_keeps_expected_reviews.
F9 low ship.py:248-252: before re-running an interrupted rollback, check whether a rollback/<short> PR is already merged;
   if so record it as done. test_resume_detects_merged_rollback.
F10 low watchdog.py:381: the printed plist runs `uv run --project <PACKAGE_REPO> orchestrator watchdog --once`.
   test_plist_uses_project.
F11 low watchdog.py:71-84: treat a daemon.lock that is empty but held (fcntl shows it locked by another process, probe
   with a read-only open and LOCK_SH|LOCK_NB released immediately is NOT allowed; instead: empty lock file whose mtime is
   older than the file's daemon log activity... simpler: an empty lock file means "unknown", never "dead": do not
   restart, report once "daemon on old code, restart it"). test_empty_lock_is_unknown_not_dead.
Run: PYTHONPATH=tests uv run python -m unittest tests.test_ship tests.test_watchdog tests.test_daemon tests.test_spawn
tests.test_goals (pytest may be missing). Commit on the task branch.
acceptance: each of F1-F11 has its named test and it passes
tests.test_ship, test_watchdog, test_daemon, test_spawn, test_goals pass (2 known Render errors excepted)

result.summary: F1-F11 are all implemented as specified, and each named test is present. I read the source diff only; I did not run the suite. Remaining points are low-severity edge cases.

comments.issue: An empty daemon.lock now forces alive=True and never reports daemon_dead. A stale empty lock left by a dead daemon (or an empty file seen in the window between lock creation and the pid write) is never restarted, and it also suppresses running_too_long detection. The spec asks for this, but the message only says 'restart it' with no way to tell a truly dead daemon from an old-code one.

_find_pr now returns any CLOSED PR when no covering MERGED or OPEN one exists. If a goal PR merged, the goal then moved on (state reset to gating, pr_number=None), and an older unrelated CLOSED PR exists for the same head branch, ship holds 'ship PR closed' instead of opening the follow-up PR. This is an edge case, but it is a behavior regression.

advance() runs `_git(root, 'fetch', 'origin')` unchecked before _find_pr and _in_target, so a failed fetch here is ignored and those checks run on stale refs. This path does not go through the new _fetch/_FetchError.
